description: Every golden whose input or trace changed since the base commit, with its class (WG-5681, criterion 22). tests/core/conformance.test.js recomputes the classes (tools/conformance.js, goldenChanges) and checks that they are exactly these. (a) every golden: its version-1 input became the version-2 input simulationInput derives and its trace a version-2 trace, equal under strip to the version-1 trace ('version 2'); (b) fixture/expression-showcase: input edited (mixed := 1 == '1' removed, as ill-typed; WG-5681 also removed inexact := 0.1 + 0.2 and replaced quo := a / b by (a - 1) / b, and WG-5683 restored both, numbers being exact rationals, with the guard inexact == 0.3 in place of the double-rounding inexact > 0.3), trace re-recorded (WG-5683: inexact is 0.3 and quo 3.5 exactly); (c) fixture/error-type and fixture/error-guard-not-boolean: their ill-typed transitions moved to calc-bad-machine, which the elaborator refuses, so they have no trace golden (tests/core/formal-elab.test.js tests the refusals); (d) the other calc-machine goldens: input re-recorded without calc-type and calc-guard, trace equal under strip; (e) WG-5732 (in WG-5740): ws-write-conflict became the error of the write-file contract, its payload gaining code 'conflict', so exegra/conflict-resolved-by-reload, exegra/conflict-resolved-by-overwrite and exegra/cli-apply-partial-write re-record input and trace (the conflict step's payload carries the code), and every input that names a newly typed event (contract and role of operation-submitted, transaction-committed, claims-evaluation-requested, claims-evaluated, refresh-requested, projection-refreshed, engine-run-called, engine-run-finished, engine-run-intent, sim-trace-ready, write-intent, save-succeeded) is re-recorded with its trace unchanged.
